niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want psychological self-reflection, a regular meditation practice, or a tradition-based spiritual path. These are promising starting points from the options I found:

### Shadow work
- **Jung Platform — *Encounters with the Shadow***: A good first stop if you want a Jungian framework. It’s presented as suitable for beginners as well as people with prior experience, and is taught by Jungian teacher James Hollis. [Course page](https://jungplatform.com/store/encounters-with-the-shadow/partner/jrose)
- **Jung Platform — *Engage the Shadow***: A more practice-oriented option, with video and audio lessons and techniques to try in daily life. [Course page](https://jungplatform.com/course/engage-the-shadow)
- **Centre of Excellence — *Shadow Mastery Diploma Course***: A self-paced, module-based course with exercises. Consider it for structured independent study, but check the syllabus, instructor qualifications, and what “diploma” means before enrolling. [Course page](https://www.centreofexcellence.com/shop/shadow-mastery-diploma-course/)

### Meditation and spiritual practice
- **Mindful.org courses**: Practical mindfulness and meditation instruction from different teachers; useful if you want a broadly accessible, nonsectarian starting point. [Browse courses](https://www.mindful.org/courses/)
- **Mindworks**: Guided meditations, teaching videos, readings, and contemplations, including mindfulness and Buddhist-oriented courses. A fit if you want a more sustained practice with a Buddhist influence. [Browse courses](https://mindworks.org/meditation-courses/)
- **Naropa University personal enrichment**: Offers contemplative study and meditation rooted in Buddhist traditions, including courses focused on compassion and training the mind. Best if you want a more explicitly tradition-based approach. [Programs](https://www.naropa.edu/academics/personal-enrichment/)
- **Shalem’s *Closer Than Breath***: A self-paced course in Centering Prayer, an explicitly Christian contemplative practice with an interfaith framing. [Details](https://shalem.org/programs/offerings-by-shalem-graduates/)

**A sensible path:** Start with a beginner-friendly shadow-work course and a separate, short daily meditation course rather than trying to do intensive inner work all at once. Shadow work can bring up difficult emotions; choose a course that emphasizes pacing, grounding, and support. It isn’t a substitute for therapy, and if you’re dealing with trauma or significant distress, consider working with a licensed mental-health professional. Check current prices, schedules, and instructor credentials directly, since course details can change.
